title: short_addr_to_iid accepts bool and leaks TypeError
description:
## Problem

python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py short_addr_to_iid() range-checks with 0 <= short_addr <= 0xFFFF then bitwise-ORs into the RFC 4944 template.

bool subclasses int, so short_addr_to_iid(True) returns 0000:00FF:FE00:0001. float 1.0 passes the range check then raises TypeError on |, not AddrError.

unicast_prefix_based_mcast in the same file already uses type(group_id) is int and tests reject True. short_addr_dad_target() feeds this helper after a similar inclusive range check, so True becomes a DAD target.

## Where

python/src/lichen/ipv6/addr.py:81-90
python/src/lichen/link/short_addr.py:284-290 short_addr_dad_target
design: Mirror unicast_prefix_based_mcast: reject non-int before the range check so bool cannot pass as 0/1 and float cannot TypeError on bitwise OR.
acceptance_criteria: short_addr_to_iid(True), short_addr_to_iid(False), and short_addr_to_iid(1.0) raise AddrError. Integers 0..0xFFFF still match RFC 4944 vectors (0000:00FF:FE00:XXXX). Same type(x) is int guard as unicast_prefix_based_mcast.
close_reason: short_addr_to_iid now uses type(x) is int (same as unicast_prefix_based_mcast). True/False/1.0 raise AddrError; RFC 4944 0000:00FF:FE00:XXXX for 0..0xFFFF unchanged. Tests in test_addr.py.
